com.eloview.homesdk.systemManager

Class System

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.eloview.homesdk.consts.Consts
      • com.eloview.homesdk.accountManager.AccountManager
        • com.eloview.homesdk.systemManager.System
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable

    public class System
extends AccountManager
    System class provides below operations.
    • Get an auth token using getEloAccessToken.
    • Capture the device screenshot using captureScreenShot.
    • Set Device orientation in portrait, landscape, reverse-portrait or reverse-landscape using setOrientation.
    • Get Device orientation. For e.g. portrait, landscape using getOrientation.
    • Factory reset device without any user interaction. It deletes the user data partition using factoryReset.
    • Reboot the device silently using silentReboot.
    • Enable/Disable NavigationBar in Standard AndroidMode using setNavigationBar.
    • Enable/Disable StatusBar in Standard AndroidMode using setStatusBar.
    • Allow all runtime permissions so application does not pop up permission dialog using grantAllAppPermission.
    • Get property status of NavigationBar using getNavigationBar.
    • Get property status of StatusBar using getStatusBar.
    • Get property status of GrantAllAppPermission using getGrantAllAppPermission.
    • Set BackLightTimeOut property using setBacklightTimeOut.
    • Get property status of BackLightTimeOut using getBacklightTimeOut.
    • Set System Password Lock using setLockScreenPassword.
    • Change System Password Lock using changeLockScreenPassword.
    • Auto grant runtime USB permissions in Android Home Mode using autoallowUSBPermission
    • Lock or unlock the secure processor firmware on M60/M60C devices using changeFirmwareStatus
    • APIs to set/change the device pin using setLockScreenPin and changeLockScreenPin
    • A method to toggle the WiFi state using changeWifiState and get the current WiFi state using getWifiState
    • A method to clear user applications cache and userdata using clearAllAppCacheUserData and clearAppCacheUserData
    • APIs to enable ADB using enableAdb, disable ADB using disableAdb and to set custom ports for ADB using customePortAdb
    • Enable/Disable Home button on the device using enableHomeButton and disableHomeButton
    • Enable/Disable Power button on the device using enablePowerButton and disablePowerButton
    • Enable/Disable Text Editor assist menu using enableTextEditorAssistMenu and disableTextEditorAssistMenu
    • Enable/Disable the 'show more' options on the volume panel enableVPShowMore and disableVPShowMore
    • Enable/Disable Zebra Barcode scanner using enableBCR
    • Perform a scan using zebra Barcode scanner scanBCR
    • Enable/disable Elo Logging feature using enableEloLogging
    • Enable/Disable random WiFi MAC address using enableRandomWifiMacAddress
    • Enable/Disable Star Printer access from WebView via JavaScript interface enableStartPrinter) enableStarPrinter
    • check if auto allowing USB permissions is enabled or disabled using getAutoAllowUSBPermission
    • Set the device owner using setDeviceOwner, remove the device owner using removeDeviceOwner(Context, String) removeDeviceOwner}, and get the device owner status using getDeviceOwnerStatus(Context, String, Handler) getDeviceOwnerStatus}
    • Set/get the Display DPI using setDPI and getDPI
    • Set and get the current language on the device using setLanguage and getLanguage
    • Set and get the type of lock on the device setLockType and getLockType
    • Set and get the status of Multi Client IME using setMultiClientIME and getMultiClientIME
    • Set/get the NTP server URL using setNtpServerURL and getNtpServerURL
    • Set/get the NTP poll interval using setNTPPollInterval and getNTPPollInterval
    • Enable/Disable install permissions to specific apps using installSpecificAppPerm or to all apps using installAllAppPermission
    • Check which apps have install permissions using getPermToSpecificApps
    • Set/get the display resolution using setScreenSize and getScreenSize
    • Set/get the smallest pixel width as shown in developer options setSmallestPixelWidth and getSmallestPixelWidth
    • Set/get the Timezone using setTimeZone and getTimeZone
    • Enable/Disable accessibility services using setAccessibilityService
    • Enable/Disable auto Date and time using setAutoDateTime
    • Enable/Disable Bluetooth device pairing confirmation dialog for spaecific devices using setBluetoothDevicePairingConfirmation
    • Set the Date and Time on the device using setDateTime
    • Set Display size (Default/Large/Larger/Largest) using setDisplaySize
    • Set Wi-Fi network configuration using a CSV file setEloNetworkConf
    • Set Font size using setFontSize
    • Enable/Disable Idle mode using setIdleMode
    • Set Location of the device using setLocation
    • Mute/Un-mute microphone using setMicrophoneMute
    • Enable/Disable showing the password while typing it in using setPasswordStat
    • Enable/Disable Google Playprotect using setPlayProtect
    • Set/Get the reserved log space on the device using setReservedLogSpace and getReservedLogSpace
    • Set the time format on the device using setTimeFormat
    • Enable/Disable the touch sound on the device using setTouchSound
    • Set volume level for various volume types such as Alarm, Call, Media, Notification using setVolumeLevel
    • Enable/Disable the 'share' option when text is selected on the device using showTextEditorShareMenu
    • Shutdown the device using silentShutDown
    • Set the default launcher on the device using silentSetDefaultLauncher
    • Lock/unlock the secure processor firmware using changeFirmwareStatus, get the status using getSpFirmwareStatus and upgrade the firmware using spFirmwareUpgrade
    • show notification and start activity from Foreground service using startActivityFromForegroundService
    • Toggle the dark mode on the device using toggleDarkMode
    • Schedule device screen to wake up after a delay using setScreenWakeUp
    • Wake-up the device screen if it is asleep using wakeupScreen
    • Unregister the Broadcast receiver registered while using the System APIs using unregisterSystemAPIListener
    • Query device SystemProperty using getSystemProperty

      void autoAllowUSBPermission(android.content.Context context, java.lang.String accessToken, boolean grantPermission, android.os.Handler handler)
      This method is used to grant runtime usb permissions in AndroidHomeMode.
      After applying changes device requires reboot to reflect the changes.
      ON 3.0 DEVICES THIS METHOD WILL TOGGLE THE USB PERMISSIONS AND THE VARIABLE 'grantPermission' IS NOT USED.
      SO FOR EXAMPLE IF AUTOMATICALLY ALLOWING USB PERMISSIONS IS CURRENTLY NOT ENABLED FOR AN APP, CALLING
      THIS FUNCTION WILL ENABLE IT.

        public void autoAllowUSBPermission(android.content.Context context,
                                   java.lang.String accessToken,
                                   boolean grantPermission,
                                   android.os.Handler handler)
        This method is used to grant runtime usb permissions in AndroidHomeMode.
        After applying changes device requires reboot to reflect the changes.
        ON 3.0 DEVICES THIS METHOD WILL TOGGLE THE USB PERMISSIONS AND THE VARIABLE 'grantPermission' IS NOT USED.
        SO FOR EXAMPLE IF AUTOMATICALLY ALLOWING USB PERMISSIONS IS CURRENTLY NOT ENABLED FOR AN APP, CALLING
        THIS FUNCTION WILL ENABLE IT. AND IF AUTO ALLOWING USB PERMISSIONS IS CURRENTLY ENABLED, THEN CALLING
        THIS FUNCTION WILL DISBALE IT

        To reboot device use silentReboot.

        Parameters:
        context - Context
        accessToken - Offline Token
        grantPermission - boolean (true/false)
        handler - A handler to receive one of the following callback messages:

        AccountManager.TOKEN_VERIFY_FAIL
        RESPONSE_SET_GRANT_ALL_PERMISSION

        public void setScreenWakeUp(android.content.Context context,
                            java.lang.String accessToken,

                            android.os.Handler handler)
        This method is used to wake up the screen if it's asleep. This API can be used to wakeup the screen after a particular
        delay. So for example you can set your device to sleep after a particular amount of idle time using setBackLightTimeout
        and set a wakeup time again using this API.
        Parameters:
        context - A context object of the calling Class (Activity/Service).
        accessToken - online token or offline JWT Token
        delay - This parameter is a long integer value describing the number of milliseconds after which to wake up the screen. For e.g. 15 seconds = 15*1000. and 30 minute = 30*60*1000 and 8 hours = 8*60*60*1000.
        handler - A handler to receive one of the following callback messages:

        SCREEN_WAKE_UP
